lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of discrete, high-luminance circular spots are arranged in a quasi-rectilinear grid posterior to the gill slits along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating visible anchor nodes that define a grid-like pattern across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and shadows on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A small blue-pigmented teleost fish is positioned externally over the third and fourth gill slits.
